review_notes: Headquarters address on plaid.com/legal/ is a PO Box mailing address ('PO Box 7775 #35278 San Francisco, California 94120-7775 U.S.A.') rather than a street office address; Plaid's careers pages separately label San Francisco as 'San Francisco HQ', corroborating the city but not adding a street address. products.names is a representative subset of a much longer list of named Plaid products shown in the site's own navigation (Enrich, Assets, LendScore, Layer, Investments Move, Cash Advance Index, Core Exchange, Permissions Manager, App Directory, etc. also appear on-site but were omitted here for brevity -- a human should decide whether to include the full list). Plaid's Partner Directory lists 100+ named companies; traction.partnerships here is a representative sample, not exhaustive. pricing.public_plans includes real plan NAMES ('Pay as You Go', 'Growth', 'Custom') published on the pricing page, but no public dollar figures are shown -- flagged since the field instructions treat named plans as sufficient for 'extracted' even without numbers.
